items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I got to talking to Clarence Ludlow... he had given up the band business and everything and I was telling him... he said I'll get you to go anywhere

ctx.x: (Side B of Tape 5 begins at this point.)

--so this time I told Burns--we can't put it on tape--he told me he wanted me to open and I explained to him what had happened, so he wanted me to open up Easter Saturday in Miami, Florida and I told him the only way I would is he would have to furnish me with six weeks contracts before I would accept it, and besides that, two weeks of deposit. So he told me okay, and we went to work and about two weeks the contracts began to come in, but before I left he sent a deposit covering two weeks--over two weeks--and so…

before I left and he said in the contract you have--he said I'll get you to go anywhere (inaudible). I went to a bus company in Tulsa that was in the state there, and looked over a used Flexible, they wanted to know what I had to put on it and I told them, which didn't amount to much and then I showed them the contract and come to find out one of the guys there was one of the board members of the Fourth National Bank where I was doing business and he told him to let me have any bus I want. So Clarence was right…
